<!--
  ============================================================================
  BUOI 6 - MUC 15 DIEM - GIAO DIEN WEB (CHUONG TRINH 1)
  ============================================================================
  Toan bo dashboard nam trong DUNG MOT node ui_template. Giao dien la
  HTML/CSS/JS tu viet, khong dung widget dung san cua node-red-dashboard, de
  kiem soat duoc bo cuc "gon dung mot khung hinh, khong thanh cuon".

  DAP UNG YEU CAU DE BAI
    Muc do 3  - 6 nut nhan dieu khien 3 LED          -> panel "DIEU KHIEN LED"
              - hien thi nhiet do, do am             -> 2 the so lieu + 2 do thi
              - hien thi trang thai LED              -> den bao + nhan BAT/TAT
    Nang cao  - hen gio bat tat relay                -> panel "RELAY & HEN GIO"
              - nhap text toi da 16x2 gui len server -> panel "TEXT LEN LCD 16x2"
  ============================================================================
-->

<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   1. EP KHUNG CUA NODE-RED-DASHBOARD GIAN HET MAN HINH

   node-red-dashboard (ban AngularJS) boc widget trong <md-card> co chieu rong
   co dinh tinh bang pixel theo ui_group, va md-content cua no tu bat thanh
   cuon. Muon dashboard chiem tron man hinh thi phai ep ca chuoi container cha.
   ========================================================================== */
.nr-dashboard-theme .card-panel { background: transparent !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
.nr-dashboard-template.nr-dashboard-template,
.nr-dashboard-cardcontainer, .nr-dashboard-cardpanel, ui-card-panel,
.masonry-container {
  width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; left: 0 !important;
  position: relative !important; overflow: hidden !important;
  padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important;
}
md-content.nr-dashboard-theme, md-content._md { overflow: hidden !important; }
/* Node-RED tu chen mot dong tieu de ten ui_group phia tren widget - an di vi
   dashboard da co thanh tieu de rieng. */
.nr-dashboard-cardtitle { display: none !important; }

/* ==========================================================================
   2. BANG MAU

   Nen toi kieu "phong dieu khien": do tuong phan cao de quay video van doc ro,
   va mau chuc nang (xanh la = dang bat, xam = dang tat, ho phach = dang cho).
   ========================================================================== */
#iot-root {
  --nen:        #080c17;
  --nen-panel:  #101827;
  --nen-o:      #17203450;
  --vien:       #1f2c45;
  --vien-sang:  #2f4266;
  --chu:        #e8eef9;
  --chu-mo:     #8394b0;
  --chu-rat-mo: #5b6a85;
  --nhan-manh:  #22d3ee;
  --bat:        #34d399;
  --tat:        #46536b;
  --cho:        #fbbf24;
  --loi:        #f87171;
  --nhiet:      #fb923c;
  --am:         #38bdf8;

  /* Khoang cach gom lai mot cho de thu gon ca giao dien theo chieu cao man
     hinh chi bang cach doi 6 bien nay (xem muc 11). */
  --khe: 14px;              /* khe giua cac panel */
  --le: 20px;               /* le trai/phai */
  --pad-panel: 13px 15px 15px;
  --pad-hang: 9px 11px;     /* padding mot hang thiet bi */
  --khe-hang: 8px;          /* khe giua 2 hang thiet bi */
  --pad-dau: 12px;          /* khoang cach duoi tieu de panel */

  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 5;
  background: var(--nen);
  color: var(--chu);
  font-family: "Inter", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
#iot-root *, #iot-root *::before, #iot-root *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

/* ==========================================================================
   3. THANH TIEU DE
   ========================================================================== */
.thanh-tieu-de {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #111c31, #0c1424);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vien);
}
.logo {
  width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--nhan-manh), #3b82f6);
  color: #06121c; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700;
}
.tieu-de-chinh { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .2px; }
.tieu-de-phu   { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--chu-rat-mo); letter-spacing: .6px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.dem-tieu-de   { flex: 1 1 auto; }

.vien-trang-thai {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--nen-o); border: 1px solid var(--vien);
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;
}
.cham { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tat); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.cham.song  { background: var(--bat); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #34d39926; }
.cham.cho   { background: var(--cho); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fbbf2426; }
.cham.loi   { background: var(--loi); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #f8717126; }
.dong-ho { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .5px; }
.ngay    { font-size: 11px; color: var(--chu-rat-mo); text-align: right; }

/* ==========================================================================
   4. BO CUC - CSS GRID THEO VUNG

   Nam panel duoc dat ten vung (cambien / dothi / led / relay / text) roi
   grid-template-areas sap xep lai theo tung co man hinh. Lam vay thay vi long
   2 the <div class="cot"> vi cot long nhau KHONG the doi thu tu theo man
   hinh - ma day chinh la thu can lam: man hinh thap thi phai tra panel sang
   cot khac, khong thi cot phai tran ra ngoai.

   VUNG 'dothi' luon la vung DUY NHAT co the co gian (minmax(0,1fr)) - no hut
   het cho trong con thua. Bon vung kia giu dung chieu cao noi dung.
   ========================================================================== */
.than {
  flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--khe); padding: var(--khe) var(--le) 0;
  /* overflow-y:auto chu KHONG PHAI hidden. Bo cuc da tinh de vua man hinh, day
     chi la luoi an toan: neu co co man hinh nao van khong vua thi nguoi dung
     CUON XUONG BAM DUOC, con hidden thi nut bien mat khong dau vet - dung lo
     hong da lam nguoi dung khong gui duoc text. Tha co thanh cuon con hon mat
     nut bam. */
  overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden;

  /* Mac dinh: man hinh rong va cao (laptop >=1200x880) */
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(330px, 400px);
  /* HANG CUOI LA 1fr VA DE TRONG BEN PHAI.
     Truoc day hang chua Text chinh la hang 1fr (hut cho thua). Khi cho thua it
     hon chieu cao that cua panel Text - xay ra o khoang cao 880-930px, vi du
     man hinh 1440x900 - thi panel bi bop nho lai, phan duoi tran ra ngoai va bi
     overflow:hidden XEN MAT, keo theo ca NUT GUI TEXT. Nguoi dung khong bam
     duoc vi nut khong con ton tai tren man hinh. Da do duoc: nut nam o 843-873
     trong khi khung chi den 851.
     Gio Text nam o hang 'auto' (luon du chieu cao noi dung), con cho thua dua
     het xuong hang 4 de DO THI hut - do thi co gian duoc, panel dieu khien thi
     khong. */
  grid-template-rows: auto auto auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas:
    "cambien led"
    "dothi   relay"
    "dothi   text"
    "dothi   .";
}
.o-cambien { grid-area: cambien; }
.o-dothi   { grid-area: dothi; }
.o-led     { grid-area: led; }
.o-relay   { grid-area: relay; }
.o-text    { grid-area: text; }

/* Panel khong phai do thi thi bam dinh vung, khong bi keo gian ra lam thua
   khoang trong o duoi. */
.o-led, .o-relay, .o-text { align-self: start; }
/* Cam bien GIAN het hang: o bo cuc 3 cot, hang 1 cao bang panel LED nen neu
   khong gian thi phan cam bien de trong mot mang lon o duoi. Gian ra thi 2 the
   so lieu cao len, chu so to hon - dung cho chu khong phai vung trong. */
.o-cambien, .o-dothi { align-self: stretch; }

.panel {
  background: var(--nen-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--vien);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: var(--pad-panel);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.dau-panel {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.1px;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--chu-mo);
  margin-bottom: var(--pad-dau); flex: 0 0 auto;
}
/* Ten panel KHONG duoc xuong dong - o bo cuc 3 cot, cot hep lam
   "DIEU KHIEN LED" vo thanh 2 dong, day panel xuong va lech het hang. */
.dau-panel > span:first-child { white-space: nowrap; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.dau-panel .gach { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 6px; height: 1px; background: var(--vien); }
/* Ghi chu la thu HY SINH duoc: hep qua thi cat bot bang dau ... */
.dau-panel .ghi-chu {
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--chu-rat-mo);
  letter-spacing: .3px; text-transform: none;
  flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   5. THE SO LIEU CAM BIEN
   ========================================================================== */
.hang-so-lieu { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
.the-so-lieu {
  background: var(--nen-o); border: 1px solid var(--vien);
  border-radius: 11px; padding: 12px 14px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--vien-sang);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; min-height: 0;
}
.the-so-lieu.nhiet { border-left-color: var(--nhiet); }
.the-so-lieu.am    { border-left-color: var(--am); }
.ten-so-lieu { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .8px; color: var(--chu-mo); font-weight: 600; }
.gia-tri-so-lieu { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-top: 2px; }
.gia-tri-so-lieu .dv { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--chu-mo); margin-left: 3px; }
.the-so-lieu.nhiet .gia-tri-so-lieu { color: var(--nhiet); }
.the-so-lieu.am    .gia-tri-so-lieu { color: var(--am); }
.chan-so-lieu { font-size: 11px; color: var(--chu-rat-mo); margin-top: 3px; }
/* So lieu qua han: lam mo con so va doi vien sang mau canh bao, de khong ai
   nhin thoang qua ma tuong do la gia tri dang cap nhat. */
.the-so-lieu.qua-han { border-left-color: var(--cho) !important; }
.the-so-lieu.qua-han .gia-tri-so-lieu { color: var(--chu-rat-mo) !important; }
.chan-so-lieu .qua-han-chu { color: var(--cho); font-weight: 700; }

/* ==========================================================================
   6. DO THI SVG
   ========================================================================== */
.khung-do-thi { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.mot-do-thi { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 44px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.nhan-do-thi { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--chu-mo); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.nhan-do-thi b { font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .5px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.nhan-do-thi .khoang { margin-left: auto; color: var(--chu-rat-mo); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
/* Khung ve phai position:relative de neo o gia tri noi (.o-gia-tri) theo toa
   do pixel that cua diem vua bam, thay vi ghim co dinh o mot goc. */
.khung-ve { position: relative; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
.khung-ve svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.luoi { stroke: var(--vien); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3 4; }
.nhan-truc { fill: var(--chu-rat-mo); font-size: 9.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
/* Vung bam rong hon cham ve (r=3.4) de tren dien thoai / iPad ngon tay van
   trung - stroke trong suot lam vien bat su kien. */
.diem { cursor: pointer; stroke: transparent; stroke-width: 9; }
/* Duong ke soc doc va cham sang PHAI pointer-events:none, neu khong chung se
   che mat cham du lieu ben duoi va bam lan 2 khong an. */
.ke-chon { stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; pointer-events: none; }
.diem-chon { stroke: var(--chu); stroke-width: 2; pointer-events: none; }
.o-gia-tri {
  position: absolute; width: 136px; text-align: center; pointer-events: none;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #04212c;
  background: var(--nhan-manh); border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
}
.goi-y {
  position: absolute; left: 36px; bottom: 1px;
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--chu-rat-mo); pointer-events: none;
}
.trong-do-thi {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center;
  color: var(--chu-rat-mo); font-size: 12px; pointer-events: none;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   7. HANG DIEU KHIEN LED / RELAY
   ========================================================================== */
.hang-thiet-bi {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px;
  padding: var(--pad-hang); border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--nen-o); border: 1px solid var(--vien);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--tat);
  transition: border-left-color .18s ease;
}
.hang-thiet-bi + .hang-thiet-bi { margin-top: var(--khe-hang); }
.hang-thiet-bi.dang-bat { border-left-color: var(--bat); }
.bieu-tuong { font-size: 19px; width: 24px; text-align: center; flex: 0 0 auto; filter: grayscale(1) opacity(.5); transition: filter .18s ease; }
.hang-thiet-bi.dang-bat .bieu-tuong { filter: none; }
.ten-thiet-bi { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
.ten-thiet-bi .ten { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.ten-thiet-bi .chan { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--chu-rat-mo); }
.nhan-trang-thai {
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .7px;
  padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 5px;
  background: #46536b33; color: var(--chu-mo); flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.hang-thiet-bi.dang-bat .nhan-trang-thai { background: #34d39922; color: var(--bat); }

.cap-nut { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.nut {
  border: 1px solid var(--vien-sang); background: #1a2438; color: var(--chu);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 13px;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .14s ease; white-space: nowrap;
}
.nut:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #243252; border-color: #3f5480; }
.nut:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
.nut:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.nut.bat.chon  { background: var(--bat); border-color: var(--bat); color: #05261a; }
.nut.tat.chon  { background: #55627a; border-color: #55627a; color: #0b1220; }
.nut.chinh {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--nhan-manh), #3b82f6);
  border-color: transparent; color: #06121c; font-weight: 700;
}
.nut.chinh:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); }
/* "Mo di" thay cho disabled: van bam duoc, van nhan duoc su kien click. */
.nut.mo-di { opacity: .5; }
/* HAI NUT GUI PHAI KHAC HAN NHAU.
   Truoc day ca hai cung mau xanh, cung rong 100%, cung nam day panel - nguoi
   dung bam nham nut Lich khi dinh gui Text (da bat duoc trong log). Gio tach
   mau: Text = xanh ngoc, Lich = ho phach, kem bieu tuong khac nhau. */
.nut.chinh.nut-text {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2dd4bf, #22d3ee);
  border-color: transparent; color: #04212c;
}
.nut.chinh.nut-lich {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbbf24, #f59e0b);
  border-color: transparent; color: #2a1a02;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   8. HEN GIO
   ========================================================================== */
.cong-tac { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
.o-truot {
  width: 38px; height: 21px; border-radius: 999px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  background: #2a3550; border: 1px solid var(--vien-sang); position: relative;
  transition: background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
}
.o-truot::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px;
  width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #8fa0bd; transition: transform .18s ease, background .18s ease;
}
.cong-tac.mo .o-truot { background: #34d39933; border-color: var(--bat); }
.cong-tac.mo .o-truot::after { transform: translateX(17px); background: var(--bat); }

.luoi-gio { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 9px; margin-top: 11px; }
.o-nhap-gio { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.o-nhap-gio label { font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .7px; color: var(--chu-mo); font-weight: 600; }
#iot-root input[type="time"], #iot-root input[type="text"] {
  background: #0c1424; border: 1px solid var(--vien-sang); color: var(--chu);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px;
  font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; width: 100%;
}
.cap-chon-gio { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.cap-chon-gio .hai-cham { font-weight: 700; color: var(--chu-mo); }
#iot-root select {
  flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0;
  background: #0c1424; border: 1px solid var(--vien-sang); color: var(--chu);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 6px;
  font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: center; cursor: pointer; appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none;
}
#iot-root select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--nhan-manh); }
#iot-root select:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
#iot-root input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--nhan-manh); }
#iot-root input:disabled { opacity: .45; }
.giai-thich-lich {
  margin-top: 10px; padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: #22d3ee0f; border: 1px solid #22d3ee2e;
  font-size: 11.5px; color: #9fdcea; line-height: 1.45;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   9. O NHAP TEXT 16x2 + MAN HINH LCD MO PHONG
   ========================================================================== */
.dong-nhap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
.dong-nhap + .dong-nhap { margin-top: 8px; }
.so-thu-tu-dong {
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--chu-rat-mo);
  width: 16px; flex: 0 0 auto; text-align: center;
}
.dem-ky-tu {
  font-size: 10.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--chu-rat-mo);
  width: 38px; flex: 0 0 auto; text-align: right;
}
.dem-ky-tu.day { color: var(--cho); font-weight: 700; }
.man-hinh-lcd {
  margin-top: 11px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: #0b3b2e; border: 1px solid #17614a;
  font-family: "SFMono-Regular", "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
  font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; color: #7cf3c0;
  white-space: pre; overflow: hidden;
  text-shadow: 0 0 7px #34d39959;
}
.nhan-lcd { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .8px; color: var(--chu-rat-mo); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 5px; }

/* ==========================================================================
   10. THANH TRANG THAI DUOI CUNG
   ========================================================================== */
.thanh-duoi {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 9px 20px; margin-top: 14px;
  background: #0c1322; border-top: 1px solid var(--vien);
  font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--chu-mo);
}
.thanh-duoi .muc { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.thanh-duoi b { color: var(--chu); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.thanh-duoi .day-ra { margin-left: auto; }

.khung-khoa {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: #fbbf2414; border: 1px solid #fbbf2440;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--cho); white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Dang khoa thi dap nhe cho de nhan ra - nguoi dung hay bo qua dai bao tinh
   roi tuong nut hong. */
.khung-khoa:not(.ranh) { animation: dap-khoa 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes dap-khoa {
  0%, 100% { background: #fbbf2414; border-color: #fbbf2440; }
  50%      { background: #fbbf2430; border-color: #fbbf2480; }
}
.khung-khoa.ranh { background: #34d39912; border-color: #34d39938; color: var(--bat); }
.dong-ho-khoa { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.vach-khoa { width: 54px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: #ffffff1a; overflow: hidden; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.vach-khoa i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--cho); transition: width .9s linear; }

/* Thong bao noi - PHAI that noi bat. Truoc day chi hien mot dong chu nho o
   thanh duoi cung, nguoi dung khong he nhin thay. */
.toast {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 58px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 40; max-width: 86%;
  padding: 11px 20px; border-radius: 10px;

/* ==========================================================================
   11. SAP LAI BO CUC THEO MAN HINH

   Bai toan: cot phai (LED + Relay + Text) can khoang 755px chieu cao. Laptop
   1366x768 chi con 646px cho phan than -> tran, panel de len nhau.

   Hai cach chua, dung ca hai:
     (a) Tra bot panel sang cot khac khi man hinh thap hoac hep  -> muc 11.1
     (b) Thu gon khoang cach khi man hinh thap                    -> muc 11.2

   DA DO THAT bang trinh duyet: resize viewport that roi do toa do NUT GUI TEXT,
   kiem tra ca hai dieu: khung .than khong tran, VA nut nam tron trong khung.

     2560x1440  man hinh QHD roi   -> bo cuc A, nut cach day 517px
     1920x1080  man hinh FHD roi   -> bo cuc A, nut cach day 157px
     1600x900   man hinh roi       -> bo cuc A, nut cach day  50px
     1440x900   MacBook Air        -> bo cuc A, nut cach day  51px
     1366x768   laptop pho thong   -> bo cuc B, nut cach day 402px
     1280x720   laptop nho         -> bo cuc B, khong tran
     1024x768   iPad co ngang      -> bo cuc C, khong tran
      820x1180  iPad Air doc       -> bo cuc D, khong tran

   BAI HOC: ban dau bang nay liet ke ca nhung co CHUA HE DO THAT, va lan do dau
   dung cach sai - doi style cua documentElement thay vi resize viewport that,
   nen media query khong he doi va moi phep do deu ra 0 mot cach gia tao. Hau
   qua: dai chieu cao 880-930px lot luoi, panel Text bi overflow:hidden xen mat
   NUT GUI, nguoi dung bam mai khong duoc ma khong hieu tai sao.
   Chi ghi vao bang nay nhung co DA THUC SU resize viewport va do lai.
   ========================================================================== */

/* ---- 11.1.B · RONG NHUNG THAP (laptop 1366x768, 1536x864): 3 cot ----
   Cot phai khong chua noi ca 3 panel -> tach Text sang cot thu ba. */
@media (min-width: 1200px) and (max-height: 880px) {
  .than {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(290px, 350px) minmax(290px, 350px);
    grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-areas:
      "cambien led   text"
      "dothi   relay text"
      "dothi   .     .";
  }
}

/* ---- 11.1.C · TRUNG BINH (iPad ngang 1024-1199): 2 cot, Text xuong duoi trai ----
   Relay trai dai 2 hang de du cho, Text nam duoi do thi. */
@media (min-width: 900px) and (max-width: 1199px) {
  .than {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(310px, 370px);
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    grid-template-areas:
      "cambien led"
      "dothi   relay"
      "text    relay";
  }
}

/* ---- 11.1.D · IPAD DOC (768-899): 2 cot cho phan dieu khien ---- */
@media (min-width: 600px) and (max-width: 899px) {
  .than {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
    grid-template-areas:
      "cambien cambien"
      "dothi   dothi"
      "led     relay"
      "text    text";
  }
  .thanh-tieu-de { flex-wrap: wrap; }
}

/* ---- 11.1.E · DIEN THOAI (<600): 1 cot, day la co man hinh DUY NHAT duoc
   phep cuon doc - nhoi 5 panel vao mot man hinh dien thoai thi chu se nho
   den muc khong doc noi. ---- */
@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .than {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: none;
    grid-auto-rows: auto;
    grid-template-areas: "cambien" "dothi" "led" "relay" "text";

  .o-dothi { min-height: 230px; }

  .thanh-tieu-de { padding: 10px 14px; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .tieu-de-phu { display: none; }
  .thanh-duoi { gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
}

/* ---- 11.2 · THU GON KHOANG CACH THEO CHIEU CAO ----
   Chi doi 6 bien khoang cach o :root cua #iot-root, khong dung den bo cuc.
   Tiet kiem khoang 60px (muc 1) va 110px (muc 2) cho moi cot.

   NGUONG 1000px, KHONG PHAI 880px: cot phai o bo cuc A can

             da bam. De nut luon bam duoc, bam xong no tu noi vi sao khong gui. -->
        <button class="nut chinh nut-text" style="margin-top:11px;width:100%" ng-click="guiText()"
                ng-class="{'mo-di': khoa.dangKhoa || !textDaDoi()}">
          <span ng-if="khoa.dangGui">⏳ Đang gửi lệnh trước…</span>
          <span ng-if="!khoa.dangGui && khoa.dangKhoa">🔒 Chờ {{ khoa.conLai }}s — nút TEXT</span>
          <span ng-if="!khoa.dangKhoa && textDaDoi()">📤 GỬI TEXT lên LCD</span>
          <span ng-if="!khoa.dangKhoa && !textDaDoi()">📤 TEXT đã khớp với server</span>
        </button>
      </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Thong bao noi: hien giua man hinh duoi, tu tat sau vai giay -->
  <div class="toast" ng-if="toast" ng-class="toast.kieu">{{ toast.chu }}</div>

  <!-- ================= THANH TRANG THAI ================= -->
  <div class="thanh-duoi">
    <div class="muc">
      <span class="cham" ng-class="{'cho': khoa.dangKhoa, 'song': !khoa.dangKhoa}"></span>
      <span ng-if="!khoa.dangKhoa">Nút đang mở — bấm được 1 lệnh</span>
      <span ng-if="khoa.dangKhoa">Nút đang khoá — còn <b>{{ khoa.conLai }}s</b></span>
    </div>
    <div class="muc">Ghi lệnh gần nhất: <b>{{ ghiCuoi || '--:--:--' }}</b><span ng-if="doTreGhi"> ({{ doTreGhi }}ms)</span></div>
    <div class="muc">Đọc cảm biến: <b>{{ docCamBienCuoi || '--:--:--' }}</b></div>
    <div class="muc">Đọc lệnh: <b>{{ docLenhCuoi || '--:--:--' }}</b></div>
    <div class="muc day-ra" ng-if="thongBao">{{ thongBao }}</div>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="text/javascript">
(function (scope) {
  'use strict';

  // =========================================================================
  // TRANG THAI GIAO DIEN
  //
  // mongMuon = trang thai NGUOI DUNG muon. Giao dien doi ngay khi bam nut
  // (lac quan) roi moi gui len server - neu cho ThingSpeak xac nhan moi doi
  // thi nut se tre 1-16 giay, bam xong tuong nhu khong an.
  // Lan doc channel LENH ke tiep se dong bo lai neu co sai lech.
  // =========================================================================
  scope.mongMuon = {
    led1: false, led2: false, led3: false,
    relay: false,
    batLich: false, gioBat: '18:00', gioTat: '22:00',
    text: '|'                                  // "dong1|dong2", '|' = ca hai dong trong
  };

  scope.danhSachLed = [
    { ma: 'led1', ten: 'LED 1', chan: 'GPIO5 · cổng D5' },
    { ma: 'led2', ten: 'LED 2', chan: 'GPIO16 · cổng D16' },
    { ma: 'led3', ten: 'LED 3', chan: 'GPIO18 · cổng D18' }
  ];

  // O NHAP TAM cua 2 panel co nut "gui" rieng. Tach khoi mongMuon de nguoi
  // dung go xong moi gui - neu go den dau gui den do thi moi ky tu an mot
  // suat ghi 15 giay.
  scope.nhapLich  = { batLich: false, batH: '18', batM: '00', tatH: '22', tatM: '00' };

  // Danh sach cho 4 the <select> gio/phut. Sinh du ca 24 gio va ca 60 phut -
  // neu chi sinh phut theo buoc 5 thi lich doc ve tu server co phut la 07 se
  // khong khop option nao va the select hien trong.
  scope.dsGio  = [];
  scope.dsPhut = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < 24; i++) scope.dsGio.push(('0' + i).slice(-2));
  for (var j = 0; j < 60; j++) scope.dsPhut.push(('0' + j).slice(-2));
  scope.nhapDong1 = '';
  scope.nhapDong2 = '';

  // Doi moi lan sua giao dien - de doi chieu voi ban dang chay tren Pi.
  scope.soHieuBan = '1537';

  scope.moiNhat = { nhietDo: null, doAm: null, thoiGian: null, mocIso: null };
  scope.soMau = 0;

  // =========================================================================
  // CANH BAO SO LIEU QUA HAN
  //
  // CT2 gui moi 20 giay. Neu qua 75 giay (lo 3 ky lien tiep) ma chua co ban
  // ghi moi thi cam bien hoac mang dang co van de - con so tren the KHONG con
  // la gia tri hien tai nua.
  //
  // Truoc day the van in "26.6 °C" to dung kem dong chu nho "luc 14:59:19".
  // Nhin thoang qua tuong dang cap nhat, trong khi so do da cu 20 phut. Gio
  // lam mo con so va doi vien sang mau canh bao de khong the nham.
  // =========================================================================
  var NGUONG_QUA_HAN_MS = 75 * 1000;

  function tuoiSoLieuMs() {
    if (!scope.moiNhat.mocIso) return null;
    var t = new Date(scope.moiNhat.mocIso).getTime();
    return isNaN(t) ? null : (Date.now() - t);
  }

  scope.soLieuQuaHan = function () {
    var tuoi = tuoiSoLieuMs();
    return tuoi !== null && tuoi > NGUONG_QUA_HAN_MS;
  };

  scope.moTaTuoiSoLieu = function () {
    var tuoi = tuoiSoLieuMs();
    if (tuoi === null) return '';
    var giay = Math.floor(tuoi / 1000);
    if (giay < 120) return giay + ' giây';
    var phut = Math.floor(giay / 60);
    if (phut < 60) return phut + ' phút';
    return Math.floor(phut / 60) + ' giờ ' + (phut % 60) + ' phút';
  };

  // Trang thai khoa nut, do node DIEU PHOI GHI ben Node-RED bao sang.
  // dangKhoa = true  -> ca 10 nut bi disable (yeu cau: moi lan chi bam 1 nut)
  scope.khoa = { dangKhoa: false, dangGui: false, conLai: 0, ghiChu: '' };
  scope.doTreGhi = null;
  scope.ketNoi = 'cho';
  scope.nhanKetNoi = 'Đang kết nối…';
  scope.thongBao = '';
  scope.ghiCuoi = null;
  scope.docCamBienCuoi = null;
  scope.docLenhCuoi = null;
  scope.chon = { nhietDo: null, doAm: null };

  scope.rongDoThi = 600;
  scope.caoDoThi = 120;
  scope.duongNhietDo = ''; scope.duongDoAm = '';
  scope.diemNhietDo = []; scope.diemDoAm = [];
  scope.luoiNhietDo = []; scope.luoiDoAm = [];
  scope.nhietDoMin = null; scope.nhietDoMax = null;
  scope.doAmMin = null; scope.doAmMax = null;

  var lichSu = [];
  var daNhanTrangThaiDau = false;

  // =========================================================================
  // DONG HO
  // =========================================================================
  function capNhatDongHo() {
    var t = new Date();
    scope.chuoiDongHo = t.toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour12: false });
    scope.chuoiNgay = t.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { weekday: 'short', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
  }
  capNhatDongHo();
  setInterval(function () { scope.$apply(capNhatDongHo); }, 1000);

  // =========================================================================
  // GUI LENH  -  MOI LAN DUNG MOT NUT, ROI KHOA 15 GIAY
  //
  // Quy tac: nguoi dung bam 1 nut -> gui ngay -> ca 10 nut bi khoa 15 giay ->
  // moi bam duoc nut tiep theo. Node DIEU PHOI GHI ben Node-RED giu dong ho
  // khoa va bao nguoc lai day (message loai 'khoa').
  //
  // VAN GUI CA 6 FIELD trong mot request du chi doi 1 nut. Hai cai loi:
  //   - Dong feed moi nhat tren ThingSpeak luon day du 6 field, Pi chi can
  //     1 request la doc duoc toan bo trang thai.
  //   - Neu co lenh nao truoc do roi mat thi lan ghi nay tu vá lai.
  // =========================================================================
  function goiLenhDayDu() {
    return {
      led1:  scope.mongMuon.led1 ? 1 : 0,
      led2:  scope.mongMuon.led2 ? 1 : 0,
      led3:  scope.mongMuon.led3 ? 1 : 0,
      relay: scope.mongMuon.relay ? 1 : 0,
      text:  scope.mongMuon.text || '|',
      lich:  chuoiLich(scope.mongMuon)
    };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // THONG BAO NOI
  // Truoc day ly do "khong gui duoc" chi hien mot dong chu nho o thanh duoi
  // cung - khong ai nhin thay. Gio hien giua man hinh, tu tat sau 5 giay.
  // =========================================================================
  scope.toast = null;
  var henTatToast = null;
  function baoToast(chu, kieu) {
    scope.toast = { chu: chu, kieu: kieu || 'ok' };
    clearTimeout(henTatToast);
    henTatToast = setTimeout(function () {
      scope.$apply(function () { scope.toast = null; });
    }, 5000);
  }

  // Bao ve Node-RED moi lan nguoi dung BAM MA KHONG GUI DUOC. Khong co cai
  // nay thi khi nguoi dung bao "bam khong an", log phia server trong tron -
  // khong phan biet duoc "ho chua bam" voi "ho bam ma bi chan".
  function baoNodeRed(moTa) {
    scope.send({ topic: 'ghi_chu', payload: { moTa: moTa } });
  }

  function guiLenh(moTa) {
    if (scope.khoa.dangKhoa) return false;
    scope.send({ topic: 'lenh', payload: Object.assign(goiLenhDayDu(), { moTa: moTa }) });
    // Khoa ngay tai giao dien, khong cho message xac nhan tu Node-RED ve moi
    // khoa - trong khoang vai chuc mili giay do nguoi dung van bam duoc nut
    // thu hai.
    scope.khoa.dangKhoa = true;
    scope.khoa.dangGui = true;
    scope.thongBao = '⏳ Đang gửi: ' + moTa;
    return true;
  }

  scope.datLed = function (ma, bat) {
    var muon = !!bat;
    if (scope.khoa.dangKhoa || scope.mongMuon[ma] === muon) return;
    var cu = scope.mongMuon[ma];
    scope.mongMuon[ma] = muon;                    // doi giao dien ngay (lac quan)
    if (!guiLenh(ma.toUpperCase() + ' → ' + (muon ? 'BẬT' : 'TẮT'))) {
      scope.mongMuon[ma] = cu;                    // bi khoa -> tra lai nhu cu
    }
  };

  scope.datRelay = function (bat) {
    var muon = !!bat;
    if (scope.khoa.dangKhoa || scope.mongMuon.batLich) return;
    if (scope.mongMuon.relay === muon) return;
    var cu = scope.mongMuon.relay;
    scope.mongMuon.relay = muon;
    if (!guiLenh('RELAY → ' + (muon ? 'ĐÓNG' : 'NGẮT'))) scope.mongMuon.relay = cu;
  };

  // ---------- HEN GIO: go vao o nhap tam, bam nut moi gui ----------
  function chuoiLich(o) {
    return (o.batLich ? '1' : '0') + '|' + (o.gioBat || '00:00') + '|' + (o.gioTat || '00:00');
  }

  function chuoiLichNhap() {
    return (scope.nhapLich.batLich ? '1' : '0') + '|' +
           scope.nhapLich.batH + ':' + scope.nhapLich.batM + '|' +
           scope.nhapLich.tatH + ':' + scope.nhapLich.tatM;
  }

  scope.doiCongTacLich = function () {
    // KHONG kiem tra khoa: cong tac nay chi doi O NHAP TAM, chua gui gi len
    // server. Trong 15 giay cho khoa nguoi dung van chuan bi duoc lich va go
    // duoc text, den luc mo khoa thi bam "Ap dung" mot phat la xong - thay vi
    // ngoi nhin man hinh dong bang.
    scope.nhapLich.batLich = !scope.nhapLich.batLich;
  };

  scope.lichDaDoi = function () {
    return chuoiLichNhap() !== chuoiLich(scope.mongMuon);
  };

  scope.guiLich = function () {
    if (scope.khoa.dangKhoa) {
      baoToast(scope.khoa.dangGui ? '⏳ Lệnh trước chưa có kết quả, đợi 1-2 giây'
               : '🔒 Đang khoá — còn ' + scope.khoa.conLai + ' giây nữa mới gửi được', 'cho');
      baoNodeRed('bam AP DUNG LICH nhung dang khoa, con ' + scope.khoa.conLai + 's');
      return;
    }
    if (!scope.lichDaDoi()) {
      baoToast('Lịch đang giống hệt trên server — chỉnh giờ rồi bấm lại', 'cho');
      baoNodeRed('bam AP DUNG LICH nhung lich khong khac server');
      return;
    }
    var cu = chuoiLich(scope.mongMuon);
    var moi = chuoiLichNhap();
    scope.mongMuon.batLich = scope.nhapLich.batLich;
    scope.mongMuon.gioBat = scope.nhapLich.batH + ':' + scope.nhapLich.batM;
    scope.mongMuon.gioTat = scope.nhapLich.tatH + ':' + scope.nhapLich.tatM;
    if (!guiLenh('Lịch hẹn giờ → ' + moi)) {
      var pc = cu.split('|');                    // bi khoa -> tra lai nhu cu
      scope.mongMuon.batLich = (pc[0] === '1');
      scope.mongMuon.gioBat = pc[1];
      scope.mongMuon.gioTat = pc[2];
    }
  };

  // Trang thai relay THUC TE: do lich quyet dinh neu lich dang bat, khong phai
  // o nhap tam (nguoi dung co the dang go do dang ma chua bam Ap dung).
  scope.relayDangDong = function () {
    if (!scope.mongMuon.batLich) return scope.mongMuon.relay;
    return trongKhungGio(scope.mongMuon);
  };

  function sangPhut(chuoi) {
    var m = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(chuoi || '');
    return m ? (parseInt(m[1], 10) * 60 + parseInt(m[2], 10)) : null;
  }

  function trongKhungGio(o) {
    var bat = sangPhut(o.gioBat), tat = sangPhut(o.gioTat);
    if (bat === null || tat === null || bat === tat) return false;
    var t = new Date(); var bayGio = t.getHours() * 60 + t.getMinutes();
    return bat < tat ? (bayGio >= bat && bayGio < tat) : (bayGio >= bat || bayGio < tat);
  }

  scope.moTaLich = function () {
    var bat = scope.nhapLich.batH + ':' + scope.nhapLich.batM;
    var tat = scope.nhapLich.tatH + ':' + scope.nhapLich.tatM;
    if (sangPhut(bat) === sangPhut(tat)) return '⚠️ Giờ bật trùng giờ tắt — relay sẽ luôn ngắt. Chọn 2 mốc khác nhau.';
    var qua = sangPhut(bat) > sangPhut(tat);
    return 'Relay tự đóng lúc ' + bat + ' và tự ngắt lúc ' + tat +
           (qua ? ' hôm sau (khung giờ vắt qua nửa đêm).' : ' mỗi ngày.') +
           ' Hiện đang ' + (trongKhungGio({ gioBat: bat, gioTat: tat }) ? 'TRONG' : 'NGOÀI') + ' khung giờ.';
  };

  // ---------- TEXT 16x2 ----------
  function boDau(s) {
    // LCD 16x2 khong co bang ky tu tieng Viet - bo dau de xem truoc dung voi
    // cai LCD se hien (CT5 ben Pi cung bo dau y het bang unicodedata).
    return (s || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '')
                    .replace(/đ/g, 'd').replace(/Đ/g, 'D')
                    .replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, '?');
  }
  function chuanHoaText() {
    // Dau '|' la ky tu phan cach 2 dong khi gui len field5. Nguoi dung go
    // dung ky tu do thi chuoi thanh "a|b|c" va CT5 se tach sai -> thay bang
    // '/' ngay tai day. Ben CT5 cung chi lay 2 phan dau, coi nhu chot chan.
    var d1 = (scope.nhapDong1 || '').replace(/\|/g, '/').slice(0, 16);
    var d2 = (scope.nhapDong2 || '').replace(/\|/g, '/').slice(0, 16);
    return d1 + '|' + d2;
  }
  scope.xemTruocLcd = function (dong) {
    var tho = (dong === 1 ? scope.nhapDong1 : scope.nhapDong2) || '';
    var s = boDau(tho.replace(/\|/g, '/')).slice(0, 16);
    return (s + '                ').slice(0, 16);
  };
  scope.textDaDoi = function () { return chuanHoaText() !== (scope.mongMuon.text || '|'); };
  scope.doiText = function () { /* chi de Angular ve lai o xem truoc */ };
  scope.guiText = function () {
    if (scope.khoa.dangGui) {
      baoToast('⏳ Lệnh trước chưa có kết quả, đợi 1-2 giây rồi bấm lại', 'cho');
      baoNodeRed('bam GUI TEXT nhung lenh truoc chua xong');
      return;
    }
    if (scope.khoa.dangKhoa) {
      baoToast('🔒 Đang khoá — còn ' + scope.khoa.conLai + ' giây nữa mới gửi được', 'cho');
      baoNodeRed('bam GUI TEXT nhung dang khoa, con ' + scope.khoa.conLai + 's');
      return;
    }
    if (!scope.textDaDoi()) {
      baoToast('Text đang giống hệt trên server — sửa nội dung rồi bấm lại', 'cho');
      baoNodeRed('bam GUI TEXT nhung text khong khac server');
      return;
    }
    var cu = scope.mongMuon.text;
    scope.mongMuon.text = chuanHoaText();
    if (guiLenh('Text LCD → "' + chuanHoaText() + '"')) {
      baoToast('📤 Đang gửi text lên server…', 'ok');
    } else {
      scope.mongMuon.text = cu;
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // DO THI SVG
  // =========================================================================
  function doKhungDoThi() {
    var el = document.getElementById('khung-do-thi');
    if (!el || !el.clientWidth) return false;
    scope.rongDoThi = el.clientWidth;
    scope.caoDoThi = Math.max(70, Math.floor((el.clientHeight - 38) / 2));
    return true;
  }

  function dungChuoi(cacGiaTri, cacMoc) {
    var chiSo = [], gt = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < cacGiaTri.length; i++) {
      if (cacGiaTri[i] !== null && cacGiaTri[i] !== undefined) { chiSo.push(i); gt.push(cacGiaTri[i]); }
    }
    if (!gt.length) return { duong: '', min: null, max: null, diem: [], luoi: [] };

    var min = Math.min.apply(null, gt), max = Math.max.apply(null, gt);
    if (min === max) { min -= 1; max += 1; }      // tranh chia cho 0 khi moi gia tri bang nhau
    var bien = max - min;

    var traiPad = 34, phaiPad = 6, trenPad = 8, duoiPad = 8;
    var rongVe = scope.rongDoThi - traiPad - phaiPad;
    var caoVe = scope.caoDoThi - trenPad - duoiPad;
    var n = cacGiaTri.length;

    var diem = [], toaDo = [];
    for (var k = 0; k < chiSo.length; k++) {
      var i2 = chiSo[k], v = cacGiaTri[i2];
      var x = traiPad + (n <= 1 ? rongVe / 2 : (i2 / (n - 1)) * rongVe);
      var y = trenPad + caoVe - ((v - min) / bien) * caoVe;
      diem.push({ x: x.toFixed(1), y: y.toFixed(1), giaTri: v, thoiGian: gioTuIso(cacMoc[i2]) });
      toaDo.push(x.toFixed(1) + ',' + y.toFixed(1));
    }

    var luoi = [];
    [min, (min + max) / 2, max].forEach(function (v) {
      var y = trenPad + caoVe - ((v - min) / bien) * caoVe;
      luoi.push({ y: y.toFixed(1), yChu: (y + 3.4).toFixed(1), nhan: v.toFixed(1) });
    });

    return { duong: toaDo.join(' '), min: min.toFixed(1), max: max.toFixed(1), diem: diem, luoi: luoi };
  }

  function gioTuIso(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour12: false }); } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }

  function veLaiDoThi() {
    doKhungDoThi();
    var moc = lichSu.map(function (p) { return p.thoiGian; });
    var t = dungChuoi(lichSu.map(function (p) { return p.nhietDo; }), moc);
    var h = dungChuoi(lichSu.map(function (p) { return p.doAm; }), moc);

    scope.duongNhietDo = t.duong; scope.diemNhietDo = t.diem; scope.luoiNhietDo = t.luoi;
    scope.nhietDoMin = t.min; scope.nhietDoMax = t.max;
    scope.duongDoAm = h.duong; scope.diemDoAm = h.diem; scope.luoiDoAm = h.luoi;
    scope.doAmMin = h.min; scope.doAmMax = h.max;

    // Toa do vua doi -> tim lai dung diem da chon theo moc thoi gian, neu
    // khong tooltip se bien mat moi lan do thi ve lai.
    ['nhietDo', 'doAm'].forEach(function (khoa) {
      var cu = scope.chon[khoa];
      if (!cu) return;
      var ds = khoa === 'nhietDo' ? t.diem : h.diem;
      scope.chon[khoa] = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) {
        if (ds[i].thoiGian === cu.thoiGian && ds[i].giaTri === cu.giaTri) { scope.chon[khoa] = ds[i]; break; }
      }
    });
  }

  scope.chonDiem = function (khoa, p) {
    // Bam lai dung diem dang chon thi bo chon (an o gia tri di)
    var cu = scope.chon[khoa];
    scope.chon[khoa] = (cu && cu.x === p.x && cu.y === p.y) ? null : p;
  };

  // Dat o gia tri ngay canh diem vua bam, tu day sang trai/phai/xuong duoi
  // neu diem nam sat mep khung ve.
  var RONG_O_GIA_TRI = 136;
  scope.viTriTraiOGiaTri = function (p) {
    var trai = parseFloat(p.x) - RONG_O_GIA_TRI / 2;
    if (trai < 0) trai = 0;
    if (trai + RONG_O_GIA_TRI > scope.rongDoThi) trai = scope.rongDoThi - RONG_O_GIA_TRI;
    return Math.round(trai);
  };
  scope.viTriTrenOGiaTri = function (p) {
    var y = parseFloat(p.y);
    var tren = y - 26;             // mac dinh dat PHIA TREN diem
    if (tren < 0) tren = y + 12;   // diem sat mep tren -> lat xuong duoi
    return Math.round(tren);
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // BAT CLICK TREN DIEM DO THI
  //
  // TUYET DOI KHONG dung ng-click tren phan tu SVG: node-red-dashboard nap
  // AngularJS Material CUNG VOI module ngTouch (console in ra canh bao
  // "You are using the ngTouch module"). Hai cai nay xung dot, ng-click gan
  // tren <circle> KHONG BAO GIO kich hoat - bam vao diem khong co gi xay ra.
  //
  // Thay bang addEventListener native + UY QUYEN tren #iot-root: phan tu goc
  // nay ton tai xuyen suot, con cac <circle> thi bi ng-repeat ve lai moi lan
  // co du lieu moi nen khong gan truc tiep vao tung cham duoc.
  // =========================================================================
  var goc = document.getElementById('iot-root');
  if (goc) {
    goc.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
      var t = ev.target;
      if (!t || t.tagName !== 'circle') return;
      var khoa = t.getAttribute('data-chart-key');
      if (!khoa) return;
      var i = parseInt(t.getAttribute('data-chart-idx'), 10);
      var ds = (khoa === 'nhietDo') ? scope.diemNhietDo : scope.diemDoAm;
      var p = ds && ds[i];
      if (!p) return;
      scope.$apply(function () { scope.chonDiem(khoa, p); });
    });
  }

  // Vai nhip dau Angular chua render xong nen khung ve con rong 0 - do lai vai
  // lan cho den khi bo cuc on dinh, va do lai moi khi doi kich thuoc man hinh.
  var soLanDo = 0;
  var henDo = setInterval(function () {
    soLanDo++;
    if (doKhungDoThi()) scope.$apply(veLaiDoThi);
    if (soLanDo >= 12) clearInterval(henDo);
  }, 200);

  var henResize = null;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    clearTimeout(henResize);
    henResize = setTimeout(function () { if (doKhungDoThi()) scope.$apply(veLaiDoThi); }, 150);
  });

  // =========================================================================
  // NHAN DU LIEU TU NODE-RED
  // =========================================================================
  scope.$watch('msg', function (msg) {
    if (!msg || !msg.payload) return;
    var p = msg.payload;

    if (p.loai === 'du_lieu_cam_bien') {
      lichSu = p.lichSu || [];
      scope.soMau = lichSu.length;
      scope.moiNhat = p.moiNhat || scope.moiNhat;
      scope.docCamBienCuoi = gioTuIso(new Date().toISOString());
      datKetNoi(p.ok);
      veLaiDoThi();

    } else if (p.loai === 'trang_thai_server') {
      scope.docLenhCuoi = gioTuIso(new Date().toISOString());
      datKetNoi(p.ok);
      dongBoTuServer(p.giaTri);

    } else if (p.loai === 'khoa') {
      // Node-RED giu dong ho khoa (khong giu o trinh duyet) de mo 2 tab hay
      // 2 may cung luc thi ca hai deu thay dung mot dong ho.
      scope.khoa.dangKhoa = !!p.dangKhoa;
      scope.khoa.dangGui = !!p.dangGui;
      scope.khoa.conLai = p.conLai || 0;
      if (p.ghiChu) scope.thongBao = p.ghiChu;

    } else if (p.loai === 'ket_qua_ghi') {
      scope.khoa.dangGui = false;
      scope.khoa.conLai = p.conLai || 0;
      scope.khoa.dangKhoa = (p.conLai || 0) > 0;
      scope.doTreGhi = p.doTreGhi || null;
      if (p.ok) {
        scope.ghiCuoi = gioTuIso(new Date().toISOString());
        scope.thongBao = '✅ ' + (p.moTa || 'Đã ghi') + ' — entry #' + p.entryId +
                         ' (' + p.doTreGhi + 'ms)';
        baoToast('✅ Đã gửi lên server — ' + (p.moTa || '') + ' (entry #' + p.entryId + ')', 'ok');
      } else {
        baoToast('⚠️ ' + (p.thongBao || 'Ghi lên ThingSpeak thất bại'), 'loi');
        // Lenh khong len duoc server -> trang thai lac quan dang hien tren
        // giao dien la SAI. Xoa moc da-dong-bo de lan doc channel LENH ke
        // tiep (toi da 5 giay nua) keo giao dien ve dung gia tri that.
        daNhanTrangThaiDau = false;
        scope.thongBao = '⚠️ ' + (p.thongBao || 'Ghi lên ThingSpeak thất bại') +
                         ' — giao diện sẽ tự đồng bộ lại sau vài giây';
      }
    }
  });

  function datKetNoi(ok) {
    scope.ketNoi = ok ? 'ok' : 'loi';
    scope.nhanKetNoi = ok ? 'ThingSpeak online' : 'Mất kết nối ThingSpeak';
  }

  // Dong bo giao dien theo gia tri THAT tren server.
  //
  // QUAN TRONG: chi ghi de khi hang doi RANH. Dang cho gui ma ghi de thi nut
  // vua bam se bat lai ve gia tri cu (server chua kip nhan) - nguoi dung thay
  // nut "tu nhay nguoc", tuong la hong.
  //
  // Cung khong duoc thay ca object: field nao server tra ve null (chua bao gio
  // duoc ghi) ma thay tuot thi se xoa mat cac field dang dung.
  function dongBoTuServer(gt) {
    if (!gt) return;

    // Dang gui do -> KHONG ghi de. Neu ghi de thi nut vua bam se nhay nguoc
    // ve gia tri cu (server chua kip nhan), nguoi dung tuong bam hong.
    if (scope.khoa.dangGui) return;

    var lanDau = !daNhanTrangThaiDau;

    // Khong duoc thay ca object: field nao server tra ve null (chua bao gio
    // duoc ghi) ma thay tuot thi se xoa mat cac field dang dung.
    ['led1', 'led2', 'led3', 'relay'].forEach(function (k) {
      if (gt[k] !== null && gt[k] !== undefined) scope.mongMuon[k] = (Number(gt[k]) >= 1);
    });

    if (gt.text !== null && gt.text !== undefined) {
      scope.mongMuon.text = String(gt.text);
      // Chi do vao 2 o nhap LAN DAU. Cac lan sau ma do de thi nguoi dung dang
      // go dang do se bi xoa chu moi 5 giay.
      if (lanDau) {
        var phan = String(gt.text).split('|');
        scope.nhapDong1 = phan[0] || '';
        scope.nhapDong2 = phan[1] || '';
      }
    }

    if (gt.lich) {
      var l = String(gt.lich).split('|');
      if (l.length === 3) {
        var lichCuDaKhop = !scope.lichDaDoi();   // do TRUOC khi doi mongMuon
        scope.mongMuon.batLich = (Number(l[0]) >= 1);
        if (/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/.test(l[1])) scope.mongMuon.gioBat = l[1];
        if (/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/.test(l[2])) scope.mongMuon.gioTat = l[2];
        // Keo o nhap tam theo server CHI KHI nguoi dung chua sua gi do dang.
        if (lanDau || lichCuDaKhop) {
          scope.nhapLich.batLich = scope.mongMuon.batLich;
          var pb = scope.mongMuon.gioBat.split(':');
          var pt = scope.mongMuon.gioTat.split(':');
          scope.nhapLich.batH = ('0' + pb[0]).slice(-2);
          scope.nhapLich.batM = ('0' + pb[1]).slice(-2);
          scope.nhapLich.tatH = ('0' + pt[0]).slice(-2);
          scope.nhapLich.tatM = ('0' + pt[1]).slice(-2);
        }
      }
    }
    daNhanTrangThaiDau = true;
  }
})(scope);
